pages.title: Equilibrium Lattice
pages.text: Forged with Omnipotence: a law that says this machine does not change. It does not.
The fourth and perfect stabiliser: a multiblock holding it never drifts, never wears, never quenches and never faults.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.
